hypothesis: A CP-SAT portfolio layer can optimize multi-game coverage under explicit overlap constraints while preserving the frozen SMART champion selection for a single game and without changing predictive scores.
baseline: frozen champion ranking without portfolio optimization
analysis_plan: Use only SMART_3053 frozen champion scores. First verify one-game equivalence. Then solve a 4-game, 12-number candidate portfolio with CP-SAT and max pairwise overlap 3. Evaluate only operational portfolio metrics; do not claim improved draw predictability.
